statements.source_text: This Rule applies to vessels not in sight of one another when navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility.
statements.predicate: The rule applies to vessels not in sight of one another when navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility.

statements.source_text: Every vessel shall proceed at a safe speed adapted to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility.
statements.predicate: Every vessel shall proceed at a safe speed adapted to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility.

statements.source_text: A power-driven vessel shall have engines ready for immediate manoeuvre.
statements.predicate: A power-driven vessel shall have engines ready for immediate manoeuvre.

open_assumptions.source_text: not in sight of one another
open_assumptions.reason: The text does not specify criteria for determining whether vessels are in sight of one another.

open_assumptions.source_text: in or near an area of restricted visibility
open_assumptions.reason: The text supplies no visibility threshold defining restricted visibility or distance defining near such an area.

open_assumptions.source_text: a safe speed adapted to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility
open_assumptions.reason: Safe speed and its adaptation depend on circumstances and conditions whose criteria and thresholds are not supplied.
The text does not specify readiness criteria or a time limit for immediate manoeuvre.
